p, k = map(int, input().split())

parent = list(range(p))

def find_leader(x):
    if parent[x] == x:
        return x
    parent[x] = find_leader(parent[x])
    return parent[x]

def union_leaders(x, y):
    root_x = find_leader(x)
    root_y = find_leader(y)
    if root_x == root_y:
        return
    parent[root_x] = root_y

for i in range(1, p):
    if (k * i) % p != 0:
        union_leaders((k * i) % p, i)

leaders = set()
for i in range(1, p):
    leaders.add(find_leader(i))

num_groups = p if k == 1 else len(leaders)

answer = 1
for _ in range(num_groups):
    answer = (answer * p) % 1000000007

print(answer)
